title: Hosting the BioDiMoBot data workshop
titleZh: 主持 BioDiMoBot 数据研讨会
summary: Organised, hosted and led a two-day online BioDiMoBot workshop on 21–22 October 2026, bringing project partners together on data acquisition, annotation, processing workflows and the shared challenges of reliable autonomous aquatic monitoring.
summaryZh: 于 2026 年 10 月 21–22 日组织并主持了为期两天的 BioDiMoBot 线上研讨会，与项目伙伴共同讨论数据采集、标注、处理流程，以及实现可靠自主水域监测的共同挑战。
imageAlt: A video-call screen showing the BioDiMoBot workshop welcome slide with its six data streams beside the participants’ video tiles

title: Robots on stage at O2 City Hall Newcastle
titleZh: 机器人登上纽卡斯尔 O2 City Hall 舞台
summary: Brought the robots Alan and Pixel on stage for the No More Sleeping project at O2 City Hall Newcastle, where technology, storytelling and young creativity came together.
summaryZh: 带着机器人 Alan 和 Pixel 登上纽卡斯尔 O2 City Hall 的舞台，参与 No More Sleeping 项目，科技、故事与青少年的创造力在此交汇。
imageAlt: The humanoid robot Alan standing among schoolchildren on stage at O2 City Hall Newcastle during the No More Sleeping performance

title: Four Durham papers at IJCNN 2026
titleZh: 杜伦团队四篇论文亮相 IJCNN 2026
summary: The Durham team presented four papers at IJCNN 2026 in Maastricht, including UIESNN, which takes spiking neural networks underwater as part of the BioDiMoBot project. Shared by Amir Atapour-Abarghouei.
summaryZh: 杜伦团队在马斯特里赫特举行的 IJCNN 2026 上报告了四篇论文，其中包括 BioDiMoBot 项目的 UIESNN，把脉冲神经网络带到水下。由 Amir Atapour-Abarghouei 分享。
imageAlt: A conference talk at IJCNN 2026 in Maastricht with a slide asking why spiking networks suit the deep sea

title: Careers Day at Durham High School
summary: Joined the Durham team at Durham High School's Careers Day, bringing humanoid and quadruped robots to pupils curious about AI from an early age.
summaryZh: 与杜伦团队一起参加杜伦高中的职业日，把人形机器人和四足机器人带到对 AI 充满好奇的学生面前。
imageAlt: The Durham team standing with humanoid NAO robots and a quadruped robot in the school hall at Durham High School

title: Teaching Computer Vision at Durham
titleZh: 在杜伦讲授计算机视觉
summary: Delivered Computer Vision lectures at Durham, helping students connect foundational image representations and feature extraction with practical applications.
summaryZh: 在杜伦讲授计算机视觉课程，帮助学生把图像表示与特征提取的基础知识和实际应用联系起来。
imageAlt: A Computer Vision lecture in a Durham University classroom

title: Presenting image deraining research at AAAI 2026
titleZh: 在 AAAI 2026 报告图像去雨研究
summary: Presented research on spiking neural networks for image deraining at AAAI 2026, exchanging ideas with researchers and collaborators.
summaryZh: 在 AAAI 2026 上报告脉冲神经网络图像去雨研究，与研究者和合作者交流想法。
imageAlt: Shuang Chen beside the spiking neural network image deraining research poster at AAAI 2026

title: Collaborative insect imaging at Diamond Light Source
titleZh: 在 Diamond 光源开展昆虫成像合作
summary: Shared a collaborative insect imaging visit to Diamond Light Source, connecting computer vision and biology.
summaryZh: 分享在 Diamond Light Source 的昆虫成像合作访问，连接计算机视觉与生物学。
imageAlt: Preparing a specimen in a laboratory at Diamond Light Source

title: Guest lecture on Deep Learning
summary: Delivered an invited Deep Learning session at Durham, sharing ideas with an engaged group of students.

imageAlt: A guest lecture on neural network architecture in a Durham University classroom

title: DEEP-SEA at IROS 2025
summary: Presented DEEP-SEA underwater perception research at IROS 2025 and discussed embodied intelligence with the robotics community.
summaryZh: 在 IROS 2025 上报告 DEEP-SEA 水下感知研究，并与机器人社区探讨具身智能。
imageAlt: An IROS 2025 presentation on underwater image enhancement with an audience in the conference room
